purpose: Explain the Docstring Assistant tab, missing-docstring scanning, heuristic and Local AI draft generation, review decisions, report persistence, and source-write authority boundaries.
display_lines: Docstring Assistant scans selected Python source areas for missing docstrings.
The tab creates review rows and drafts candidate docstrings with either heuristic generation or an OpenAI-compatible local model.
Use one selected-row draft before running visible or all-row bulk drafts.
Treat confidence and no-uncertain settings as acceptance policy, not draft verbosity.
Reports record scan findings, drafts, and human decisions; they are not direct source-file writes.
